memories.name: Dockerfile 基础模板
memories.content: Python 项目 Dockerfile 基础模板，使用多阶段构建，包含依赖安装层和应用代码层。
memories.template_body:
FROM python:3.12-slim AS builder
WORKDIR /app
COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --user -r requirements.txt --no-cache-dir

FROM python:3.12-slim
WORKDIR /app
COPY --from=builder /root/.local /root/.local
COPY . .
ENV PATH=/root/.local/bin:$PATH
EXPOSE {port}
CMD ["python", "-m", "uvicorn", "main:app", "--host", "0.0.0.0", "--port", "{port}"]

memories.name: 数据备份脚本模板
memories.content: 通用数据备份 shell 脚本模板，支持压缩、加密、上传和保留策略。
memories.template_body:
#!/bin/bash
BACKUP_DIR="/path/to/backup"
BACKUP_NAME="backup_$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)"
tar -czf "$BACKUP_DIR/$BACKUP_NAME.tar.gz" /target/dir
gpg --encrypt --recipient {recipient_key} "$BACKUP_DIR/$BACKUP_NAME.tar.gz"
rsync -avz "$BACKUP_DIR/$BACKUP_NAME.tar.gz.gpg" remote:/backup/
find "$BACKUP_DIR" -name "*.tar.gz.gpg" -mtime +{retention_days} -delete

memories.template_body:
stages:
  - build
  - test
  - deploy
cache:
  key: ${CI_COMMIT_REF_SLUG}
  paths:
    - .pip-cache/
build:
  stage: build
  script: docker build -t {image} .
test:
  stage: test
  script: pytest tests/
deploy:
  stage: deploy
  script: docker push {image}
  only: [main]

memories.template_body:
filebeat.inputs:
- type: log
  enabled: true
  paths: [{log_path}]
  multiline.pattern: '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}'
  multiline.negate: true
  multiline.match: after
output.elasticsearch:
  hosts: [{es_hosts}]
  index: "{index_name}-%{+yyyy.MM.dd}"
setup.template.name: "{index_name}"
setup.template.pattern: "{index_name}-*"
